verdict.rationale: Featurebase says it notifies 'all relevant users when their requests are shipped', which implies each feedback request is tied to the users who submitted it. The feedback posts API also exposes individual submissions. Neither source explicitly documents attributing or linking a feedback item to a specific customer record. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of submitter or customer attribution on feedback posts, a way to manually link feedback to customers or companies, customer profile views of submitted feedback, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can link individual feedback items to the specific customers who submitted them

citations.quote: Featurebase automatically notifies all relevant users when their requests are shipped.
Returns all posts (feedback submissions) for the authenticated organization.
